name.text: test- Box Plot matched with dotplots

questiontext.text:
The following exercise shows stacked dot plots for four data sets . Match each dotplot to its respective boxplot.

min={@lim1@}, max={@lim2@}, median={@med@}, LQ={@lq@}, UQ={@uq@}

min1={@lim11@}, max1={@lim21@}, median1={@med11@}, LQ1={@lq1@}, UQ1={@uq1@}

min3={@lim33@}, max3={@lim31@}, median3={@med33@}, LQ3={@lq3@}, UQ3={@uq3@}

{@lx@}

{@lx1@}

{@lx3@}

var lim11 ={#lim11#}; var lim21 = {#lim21#}; var med11 = {#med11#}; var lq1 = {#lq1#}; var uq1 = {#uq1#}; var d11 = board.create('line', [ [lim11, 1], [lim11, 2] ], { straightFirst: false, straightLast: false, strokeWidth: 2, fixed:true }) var d22 = board.create('line', [ [lim21, 1], [lim21, 2] ], { straightFirst: false, straightLast: false, strokeWidth: 2, fixed:true }) var d33 = board.create('line', [ [med11, 1], [med11, 2] ], { straightFirst: false, straightLast: false, strokeWidth: 2, fixed:true }) var d44 = board.create('line', [ [lq1, 1], [lq1, 2] ], { straightFirst: false, straightLast: false, strokeWidth: 2, fixed:true }) var d55 = board.create('line', [ [uq1, 1], [uq1, 2] ], { straightFirst: false, straightLast: false, strokeWidth: 2, fixed:true }) var d66 = board.create('line', [ [uq1, 1], [lq1, 1] ], { straightFirst: false, straightLast: false, strokeWidth: 2, fixed:true }) var d77 = board.create('line', [ [uq1, 2], [lq1, 2] ], { straightFirst: false, straightLast: false, strokeWidth: 2, fixed:true }) var d88 = board.create('line', [ [lim11, 1.5], [lq1, 1.5] ], { straightFirst: false, straightLast: false, strokeWidth: 2, fixed:true }) var d99 = board.create('line', [ [lim21, 1.5], [uq1, 1.5] ], { straightFirst: false, straightLast: false, strokeWidth: 2, fixed:true }) //create boxplot3 var lx3 = {#lx3#};var lim33 ={#lim33#};var lim31 = {#lim31#};var med33 = {#med33#};var lq3 = {#lq3#};var uq3 = {#uq3#}; var i = 0; for (i = 0; i <= lx2.length - 1; i++) { p[i] = board.create('point', [lx2[i], ly2[i]], { face: 'x', name: '', size: 2, fixed:true }); } //Create Label for Data 2 var txt = board.create('text', [{#xmin#}+1, {#maxfreq2#}/2+2, "B"], { fontSize: 30,fixed: true });
